reviews.author: Swim Nizzle
reviews.text: There is nowhere else I would even consider for service. From my 30 fleet vehicles/ work trucks to my sports cars and imports. From seeing Amy to explain my reason to visit to talking with Joe sharing opinions and deciding on options the whole experience is stress free. The kindest, polite and professional people who you'd ever want to help you while you're dealing with car issues which are never fun or convenient. They are the most honest and work is always quality. Been a loyal customer for probably 15 years at this point and as long as they are there I will always come back. Thank you J&J!

reviews.author: Ken Mendonca
reviews.text: Was driving to OBX when my car had a tire pressure warning light come on. Used Google to find J&J and they had my car up on the rack in 10 minutes and my tire patched in another 20 minutes. The waiting room had a couple of couches and the service was very friendly. Under the circumstances, I am very happy with the service we received. I couldn't ask for anything more.

reviews.author: Paul Cappabianca
reviews.text: As I heard good things about J&J, I took my vehicle in because I needed an inspection, and I had a strange rubbing sound when I pressed on the brakes. I was expecting an answer that involved a brake job.....BUT.....what I didn't expect, was the honesty of the establishment, stating that my brakes were in excellent condition, and only needed a little lubrication to fix the rubbing noise. Excellent service, and I have now found a new mechanic....as I am new to the area!!!!

reviews.author: Melissa Register
reviews.text: Simply the best, most honest & friendly atmosphere & service! I’ll always tell people & recommend J& J !

reviews.author: Austin Leone
reviews.text: Called to make an appointment for a rotate and balance. I paid for a balance but the rotate was at no charge per the invoice. So the service I requested and was qouted wasn't done. I called to get this fixed and the tech lied and said he did it. I marked my rims(yellow front, black back) so I called him out on his shotty work. Questioned why the old wheel weights weren't pulled off and balanced correctly. The owner told me that's just how they do it there and he's gonna make the tech bring in my truck and service it now on his own time. I went to j&j twice, wasted 3 hours, Paid 52.78 and found that my rim was cracked. Couldn't tell me about it even though they had my rims and tires off the truck twice. Also the crack is where the old wheel weight was. The owner said he had to look at it but he wasn't gonna do anything for me aside maybe give me some money back. When I asked if they'd just swap my tire and tpms over on a new rim he declined. Can't do the work right and can't make the mistakes right, liability falls in the hands of the last person to touch it. Wouldn't recommend to anyone to have there vehicle serviced here

reviews.author: Michael Parziale
reviews.text: These people are about as honest and reasonably priced as you will find anywhere. Never had a problem with any of their work. We are loyal and perpetual customers of J&J.

reviews.author: Tyler Hall
reviews.text: Amazing SHOP!!! Replaced a stud/lug nut and rotated my tires. I had two other shops tell me that they would have to take apart the front of my car. I will only be going here for me car from now on.

reviews.author: Ronald Bass
reviews.text: The crew at J&J automotive are simply second to none. They do not hesitate to go out of their way to take care of me and my trucks consistently.

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.text: my wife and I can’t thank them enough. I called to make an appointment to have the air conditioner checked out on my jeep and Amy was super friendly and told me to bring it in the next day. we dropped it off at about 4 PM the day prior to the appointment and they actually took it in and had it diagnosed in less than 30 minutes. They installed the parts and had the issue on its way to being fixed it unfortunately required more parts and once again, Amy called and gave me an update. they had the parts in the next morning and the air conditioning totally fixed in a day and a half. we appreciate their quick efforts and knowledge to get the air fixed especially in this Carolina heat. You have definitely gained a customer for life. And I will always recommend them to anybody with automotive issues.

reviews.author: Madison Wessels
reviews.text: All staff were super friendly and kind. My car ac issue was inspected and fixed in less than an hour. Pricing was very reasonable. Would recommend to anyone considering this business.

reviews.author: Natalie Matheny
reviews.text: I had been struggling with a starting issue in my vehicle for 2 weeks, which I thought to be a battery problem. 3 different businesses tested my battery. 1 said it was bad and tried to sell me a new $350 battery, and 2 others said it tested fine. Alternator and starter also tested fine. I called J&J and they told me to bring my van in the same day, and by the next morning, they had solved the problem: a loose battery terminal. A $36 simple fix. 3 other businesses checked my battery, but didn't catch the loose terminal, which J&J found right away. Next time, I'll start with J&J. They were friendly, helpful, and honest, and I'm so thankful for their help!

reviews.author: Edward Eiting
reviews.text: I knew my front left wheel bearing was to blame for all of the road noise I was getting (Roaring noise that got louder when turning right). I called them on a Monday morning, was able to get an accurate estimate, and they had me in Tuesday afternoon. After the initial road test, they weren't completely sure it was the wheel bearing, but with closer inspection, there was no play in the bearing, but they confirmed the noise. They were able to quickly replace both front wheel bearings. I insisted on replacing them as a pair, because at almost 100,000 miles, the other one can't be far behind it from failing. First thing Wednesday morning, my car was ready. Because I had already diagnosed the issue, they didn't charge me the $100 diagnostic fee. The total actually came up to be a few dollars lower than the phone estimate. Immediately upon picking up the car, the difference was night and day. So smooth and no more road noise. What a relief to have this issue taken care of. It's really nice when you can find a facility that you feel like you can trust. I highly recommend J&J Automotive.

reviews.author: Meghan Dail
reviews.text: Recently had new tires put on at J&J and then had a seizing brake caliper diagnosed and repaired that a local dealership missed. Very friendly. Easy to schedule and get in quickly. Will continue to use them in the future and recommend them. Thank you!

reviews.author: Anthony Gaita
reviews.text: It is difficult to find reliable auto service techs. J and J’s prices are reasonable and they do a great job. I like that you are told up front what the problems are and the cost of the repairs. Also, Amy is very pleasant.

reviews.author: Kevin Welch
reviews.text: Fast, friendly, no hassle, very reasonable labor cost. Starter went out on jeep, looked around on Google for a shop as I'm not familiar with the area. Found J&J, close by, good reviews so I gave them a call Saturday to feel them out and get a quick quote. Felt good about the conversation and quote. Asked for Tow recommendations which they provided a very helpful tow company J&S. Upon receiving my vehicle around 10pm it was ready around 3 or 4pm. 5 star shop all the way. I could have fixed this myself at home, but home is 3hr away. For the service, price and hassle free experience this is a great establishment. Thank you

reviews.author: Debra Morton
reviews.text: This was my first time going to J&J and it certainly NOT be my last. They were able to find out what was wrong with my car and fix it all in ONE day. Very pleased with the service. Amy was extremely nice,upfront regarding pricing and helpful with any questions. Will recommend them to anyone who needs excellent customer service and workmanship.

reviews.author: Max Deplorable
reviews.text: Had my brakes looked at and they could have easily billed me for $75 and I would have felt that was totally fair. They charged me $27. The woman next to me said, "I'VE BEEN USING J AND J AUTO FOR YEARS AND THEY ARE GREAT. Just with one visit I believe this is a GREAT fair and honest auto repair place and those are to me as rare as hen's teeth.

reviews.author: Peighton Warren
reviews.text: I have never had better service anywhere else. Amy up front is wonderful. Jason and joe are awesome. They are always happy to help with any questions that you have. The other boys in the back do a great job. They are up front and honest about whats going on with your vehicle and their prices are very reasonable.

reviews.author: Amber Lenhard
reviews.text: Fast, Friendly, and Amazingly priced place to get anything & everything done for your vehicle. The customer service truly deserves 6 Stars!! Thank you for getting me in so quickly & for already helping to book future appointments!

reviews.author: Cherie Lindsay
reviews.text: Went to this place to have my oil changed via a recommendation and referral from another mechanic on 12/7. It was last minute and they were able to fit us in. The gentlemen here are so nice, kind and professional. The prices are just right and they tell you what is going on with your car in terms that you understand. I highly recommend this shop and will be taking my car here from now on. Being new to New Bern I'm so happy I found a good place to go.

reviews.author: Julie E
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Honest, reliable , and fair prices. I've worked in the automotive industry for many years and having all of my contacts 1000 miles away now I was worried about finding somewhere I could trust. I'm no longer worried!! So happy to have found them. Jason is the best!

reviews.author: Jessica Felter
reviews.text: This local non-chain automotive repair shop has thoroughly impressed me! They are courteous, up-front & honest, and genuinely want to share their knowledge and expertise with the customer! This was the first place in years, I have not felt they were out to make a buck on a woman car owner! I have 3 vehicles and they have serviced what they can on them even telling me when it was best to take it to the dealer because they do not have the digital software access for my VW needs! They could have easily just kept trying first and then sent me to the dealer!! They are also decently priced and have always made me feel my business mattered to them! I will recommend to others! Also, they keep the office and customer areas very clean! Thank you Guys!!

reviews.author: Leslie Maddox
reviews.text: Joe and Jason at J&J Automotive are so phenomenal. Each time I’ve had the pleasure of dealing with them, I’ve received nothing but professional and caring assistance and they’ve truly gone above and beyond in their service. I’ve received honest quality repairs from them at very fair prices. They are kind and patient and I truly cannot say enough good about them. They have my business and should have yours too!

reviews.author: kimmy perry
reviews.text: Jason is absolutely incredible. On a holiday I called the shop about fixing my Denali. Within an hour he had picked up the part and fixed it at a super reasonable price. I am thoroughly impressed with the quick and reliable service I received and will continue to take my vehicles to him.

reviews.author: Chad Baulch
reviews.text: J&J Automotive is hands down THE BEST place to go for your auto repair needs in New Bern!!! Joe & Jason are the most honest auto mechanics I have ever met. They never try to "up-sell" you on repairs that are not needed, but will instead advise you of repairs that are truly needed. There is absolutely no need to worry about being taken advantage of here! They are very knowledgeable, accommodating, quick, and pleasant to work with. The shop is clean and the waiting area is comfortable too! I would highly recommend J&J Automotive to ANYONE looking for honest, reliable auto repair at more than reasonable pricies!!!

reviews.author: Rick Haskett
reviews.text: Took our 2002 Ford excursion for alignment as camber on front tires was off. For years other shops said it was as good as it could get and that it couldn't be fixed, so our front tires were wearing on outside edge and truck drove terribly. With an alignment and adjustment bushings replaced, J&J completely fixed the issue in one days time and now truck drives and handles as it should. They've also replaced fuel pump on this vehicle and have done work on several of our other vehicles. We trust them completely and highly recommend! J&J is now our go to for all of our vehicle needs.

reviews.author: AE Love and Beelieve
reviews.text: Great Service my drive Is so smooth now with my new tires. Shout out to J&J friendly, fast and affordable!

reviews.author: soloflow 1
reviews.text: I have nothing but Great things to be say about J&J Automotive! I was just down in New Bern for the week visiting my son on spring break 14 hours from home in Michigan and my Ford F250 super duty broke down on me.I I couldn’t find any shop in the area to get me in as it was a Emergency With kids that needed to get back to school and wife and I needed to get back to work. I called them told them situation and they told me to bring my truck down there that day and they would take a look at it diagnose it and get it fixed for me and they did exactly that bad ground between batteries and bad alternator! They got me back on the road the next day great shop great people great service ! Thanks again J&J! So anyone in the area and have an emergency or just live around them and need work done I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Claire Mochan
reviews.text: I meant to post a five star review , my previous one was four. Sorry! My mistake. A great couple of guys who are always so helpful and courteous, no job is too much trouble and their charges are very reasonable. I have recommended them several times to friends and will continue to do so. Thank you J&J, you guys are great!

reviews.author: Scott Westra
reviews.text: We love J&J. As a military family, we move around a lot, and sometimes it's hard to find a mechanic you trust. We scored with J&J. Honest, don't do unnecessary work. I'll be sad when we move again and have to find another mechanic. *moving tomorrow, still love this place.

reviews.author: Cam Sully
reviews.text: I had some broken off exhaust manifold bolts extracted, gaskets replaced and put back together for a great price and in a timely manner. I was very impressed with their level of customer service. I recommend J and J for any automotive work.

reviews.author: Ashley Holder
reviews.text: The absolute best mechanic shop in ENC! Joe and Jason are so pleasant to work with and are very knowledgeable. My husband and I both have had our cars worked on by them on multiple occasions. I refer everyone I know to them because I know they are going to receive the same care as I get.

reviews.author: Garrett Litfin
reviews.text: I went to J&J to have them take a look at my car as it was making some strange noises every so often. I read some solid reviews online, so I thought I would give them a try. I was greeted immediately after I walked in the door, they asked me a few questions, took the vehicle for a spin to see if they could hear what I was hearing. Of course, the vehicle ran perfectly while Jason was driving it, so he put it on the lift. He then walked me through everything he was looking at, basically inspecting my suspension, power steering and other components he thought could have been making the noises I was hearing. After driving the vehicle and looking it over with me for about 30 minutes, he told me, "I don't see anything unsafe with your car, I'd drive that car to California." I'm not mechanically savvy, and my car is old, so he easily could have told me 1000 things wrong with the vehicle and I'd have taken it hook, line and sinker, but he was honest. He didn't charge me a dime for what I would call a fairly thorough inspection that took up a good chunk of his time. He just asked that I come back if the noise continues to get worse. While they didn't perform any heavy maintenance on my vehicle, honesty, customer service and integrity mean a lot to me, and these guys score high in those categories. I will continue to bring my vehicle to J&J for the remainder of my time in Eastern NC.

reviews.author: Nicolas West
reviews.text: Took my 2002 Honda CRV with 250k+ miles to them today. They immediately took a look at it and gave me an idea of what the problem was. Left the car and they finished up by the end of the day. Not only was the service quick, they were extremely upfront and honest about what needed to be done. I will definitely be bringing mine and my wife’s vehicles to them for any future needs. Great guys, great business, and definitely planning on recommending them to others.

reviews.author: RHM
reviews.text: They were great. We are part time residents and didn’t know who to use. Picked them because of their reviews. It was a wise decision. Very professional and honest. Took care of all of my issues for a very fair and reasonable price. Plan to use them again for sure.

reviews.author: Ralph Bucci
reviews.text: I am never disappointed with JJ Automotive. Their work is impeccible, thorough and professional! I was recommended by another satisfied customer who said that they are honest, hardworking and reasonably priced. I have had several cars worked on by them with difficult issues. (1995 Ford Ranger; 2009 Mustang convertible Anniversary Model. I will always have JJ Automotive work on my "babies"! Ralph Bucci

reviews.author: Andrew Davis
reviews.text: Highly recommend them! My daughter's car broke down on the way to the beach and was towed to the shop after hours. The shop took the time that night, even though they were closed, to assess the repairs needed and fixed it first thing the next morning. They are awesome!

reviews.author: Kayce James
reviews.text: The only place I take my vehicles. Everybody is so nice there and goes above and beyond for their customers. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Kevin Holley
reviews.text: My car died crossing the Neuse River Bridge on the Friday morning of Memorial Day weekend. The awesome folks at J&J got it diagnosed and a new radiator in the NEXT DAY and I picked up that same day, a Saturday. They were friendly, efficient, communicative, and their pricing was reasonable. This is what other businesses should aspire to be. Thank you J&J.

reviews.author: Lisa Zaldivar
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about the 2 guys that run this shop! I just walked in with no appt so maybe someone by chance could listen to a noise that my car was making and without any hesitation Joe said “sure, give me a few and we can take a ride” I didn’t expect that fast response at all. He told me what the noise was and he took care of it that same day! (Really didn’t expect that) AND I didn’t get price gouged. Our family will continue to go to J&J for all our future automotive needs. Thanks Joe, Lisa - Silver Ford Edge

reviews.author: drjwbriand
reviews.text: every time i need something done they are attentive friendly and courteous. their prices are great and above all else, they are very honest! i had a power steering cooler replaced on my truck in august and it started to leak in october. they took in my truck, fixed a broken clamp, refilled my fluid resevoir and when i picked it up i was blown away when i was told there was no charge!! i won't go anywhwere else! trust them, you won't be dissapointed!!

reviews.author: Bryan Arthur
reviews.text: Awesome folks. Jason knows his stuff and was able to get my truck's front-end aligned when three other shops couldn't. They've definitely earned my business, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Susie Strickland
reviews.text: Joe did an outstanding job repairing and servicing my car. Joe and Jason provide trustworthy customer service, quality and top of the line professionalism. They really do put the customer's best interest first and that is hard to find in today's world

reviews.author: John Messer
reviews.text: I brought my vehicle in at the end of the day with the dash board lit up like a christmas tree. I left it over night and issues were diagnosed and fixed by the next morning. Honest and open communication. Great experience at J&J!

reviews.author: Paul S
reviews.text: J&J was recommended to me by a neighbor. This was my second visit there. They performed all the work I requested on time and at a price that met my budget. I would highly recommend them to anyone and will be using them in the future.

reviews.author: Meagan Hendrix
reviews.text: Always great service!! Got me in and out quick for a tire plug!!! Highly recommend them! Owners are great people!!

reviews.author: Paul Branaman
reviews.text: They did a good job for me. I went in for a squeaky belt. Initially they told me I needed a new belt. But when I got my bill they told me they double checked and fixed my problem with charging me for a new one. I can't remember the last time I went to one of those corporate garages and they told me something like that. It might seem like a little thing to most people, but service like that is hard to find today.

reviews.author: jeffrey scott
reviews.text: I have replace many cv joints on multiple makes and models. Long story short. One beat me, but not Jason at J & J. Had my wife’s Nissan Pathfinder back on the road. They are great!

reviews.author: Ryan Weinstein
reviews.text: I have nothing but respect for these guys. We vacation to North Carolina several times a year and it never fails something goes wrong on a vehicle. These guys (every employee) whom I spoke with answered every question I had thoroughly and respectfully, even though I am far from a mechanic. I without a doubt, when in the area, will bring them all of my business. Did not try to upsell in fact they saved me money!! Shout out to these guys for helping out a family man!

reviews.author: Karen Ball
reviews.text: Jason and John are the epitome of customer service! They have treated both my daughter and me like family. It gives this Indiana mom a lot of reassurance to know these two are looking after my daughter’s family’s cars all the way down in North Carolina!

reviews.author: Randy Swinson
reviews.text: Standard oil change and all safety check was amazing. Found out they do A/C repairs too. This will be my mechanic from now on. Quoted me the best price on tires too.

reviews.author: Lex Caton
reviews.text: I have been taking my vehicles here for years - everyone in the shop is fantastic and will tell you exactly what’s going on with your vehicle! To include what needs to be fixed right now and what can wait, I hate that it took so long to find them but, so glad that we did!

reviews.author: Hannah Arey
reviews.text: I brought my car into these guys after I was told the fix would be more than the car was worth. They had it fixed at an amazing price and back to me in less than 24 hours. Definitely taking all of my car needs to J&J

reviews.author: Yvette Langemann
reviews.text: I Have an 89 Corvette took it to J&J to fix some running issues and brake problems no one has been able to work on this car and get it right I picked it up today it runs better than it ever has!! so pleased with their work I will recommend them to everyone I will drive from Greenville to New Bern to have them service all my vehicle's Thank you Joe, Jason and Amy

reviews.author: Joshua Shivar
reviews.text: J&J Automotive is one of the most trustworthy and best experiences for anything automotive service related. Highly recommend for anybody considering service work. You will know that you are being treated honestly and fairly as soon as you reach out to them.

reviews.author: Mandi Lewis
reviews.text: I would have to say it’s very hard to find honest and reasonably priced mechanics now days but with this shop I was 100% satisfied. Their customer service and quality of work was outstanding and I will no longer take my vehicle anywhere else but to them. Thank you guys again!

reviews.author: sean lincoln
reviews.text: I drove a recently purchased used truck down from New York to meet up with my family for an Ocracoke vacation. About an hour outside New Bern the head gasket and coolant tank blew out. I just barely made it to town, and dropped off the vehicle with these guys the next morning. Boy am I glad I did. Jim and Jason were entirely courteous, professional, and honest. By the end of the vacation they had me ready to go back to work, with a good used engine installed at a reasonable price. Jason even took a call on a Sunday morning as I drove back up to answer a question about a check engine light. If I lived in New Bern, or anywhere around New Bern, I'd take my vehicle here every time.

reviews.author: Jordan Powell
reviews.text: Joe of j&j automotive is very knowledgeable and has excellent customer service. J&J automotive is the only automotive shop in the New Bern area that I trust to handle an automotive issue without sinking a bunch of money into unnecessary parts. The work quality speaks for itself.

reviews.author: Shadi Zahed
reviews.text: We scheduled a drop off with Amy, for a brake fluid change and tire rotation. The diesel VW was ready immediately. They're open on weekends which helped immensely. I'm going to keep coming back here..

reviews.text: Excellent service, trusted local business. Have used them a number of times, always fully satisfied with the cost and work done. Highly recommended.

reviews.text: This is my new mechanic! They do wonderful work for a reasonable price! Great Customer Service at the front desk always!

reviews.author: Jason Helms
reviews.text: Im a contractor here working from mich.and was referred to these guys from a friend and have no complaints with their work they went above and beyond for me from the diagnosis to the work they did for me not to include the hundreds they saved me...i wont go anywhere else while im here the guys are great,if u have any problem with your vehicles go here!!!

reviews.author: Richard Gannon
reviews.text: Joe and Jason are both excellent mechanics, most importantly they are very honest with any information they give you regarding work needed on your vehicle.

reviews.author: Melissa Ross
reviews.text: Awesome service on my old 2005 Crossfire. Will be back. Amy was very upfront about cost. Right on point.

reviews.author: Jordan Turnmire
reviews.text: Great guys, were able to help me fix a minor tire emergency in a matter of minutes as I was from outta town and in a tough spot. Quick and friendly service!!

reviews.author: Linda O'Leary Riesch
reviews.text: They are great -- always prompt, courteous, knowledgeable and reasonable. Thus, I'm re-posting with 5 stars, since there is nothing they need to improve! :)

reviews.author: David Trader
reviews.text: Jason is fantastic. Had an issue with the family van on vacation and they fixed it quickly and at a reasonable price. Gentlemen gearheads they have there.

reviews.author: Douglas Ipock
reviews.text: So far J&J has been our go to garage for our vehicle repairs and of late that has been a lot. Friendly staff very accommodating and very reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Lois Churchill
reviews.text: Very happy with my service. Price was fair and I wasn’t sold anything I didn’t need. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Charles Pyatt
reviews.text: J&J repaired the upper arms on my Explorer for $290 after I had received an estimate for the repair of $500!! from another local shop. I will using J&J as my "go-to" car repair shop in the future.

reviews.author: Jim K
reviews.text: I have visited twice for small needs. Always courteous, helpful, and knowledgeable. Will definitely use them again for routine maintenance and unexpected problems.

reviews.author: Earl Clowers
reviews.text: If there was a 5+ star option, I would pick it. Honest hard working, good guys and better than fair pricing. Fantastic customer service.

reviews.author: Jay Bucksot
reviews.text: These folks were friendly and professional. Great work and a good price. Work was done in a very timely manner.

reviews.author: Arne Bendixen
reviews.text: Just had my SUV serviced there, great experience. Going back for other work next week, real honest guy.

reviews.author: Pete Rollins
reviews.text: Excellent experience. They are always professional and looking out for my best interest. I definitely would recommend them to my friends and family

reviews.author: FRANCISCO VILLEGAS
reviews.text: Thanks J&J Automotive for the great deal on tires and quality alignment work. I would definitely recommend for future business.

reviews.author: Stacy Parauda
reviews.text: I have used them twice. They are the best! Friendly, professional and honest! So happy to have found them.

reviews.author: Larhonda Davis
reviews.text: Jason and Joe are the best!! Very professional, reasonable with pricing and great at what they do. I recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Ellie Nein
reviews.text: Reasonable prices, cordial greeter, fair prices. Easy to get thing fixed or replaced. Has "sweet shop dog".

reviews.author: liz crafton
reviews.text: Great staff who tell you straight and won't rip you off. I was impressed with their knowledge, customer service, and professionalism.

reviews.author: Charles Herman
reviews.text: I use this company for all my service needs for my person and business . The service is A1 they are outstanding . I would highly recommend this company to everyone for personal or business needs . Best in the tri county area

reviews.author: Leverto Olmedo (Tiolc)
reviews.text: I go here for my yearly vehicle safety inspections. Great business with great employees. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: kenneth white
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable mechanics who are also very fair on their pricing. Can't go wrong by going to these guys.

reviews.author: Shannon Hallock
reviews.text: They were really sweet helping me figure out what was wrong with my car and telling me step by step how they would fix it.

reviews.author: Robert Kleppetsch
reviews.text: A couple of really great guys. They do excellent work and at a reasonable price. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rachel Martin
reviews.text: I dont plan on taking my car anywhere else to get it serviced. The prices are reasonable and they take the time to answer all my questions.

reviews.author: Toshia Marage
reviews.text: Great guys!! Fast, but great work. Friendly, informative, and just all around great guys who do great work. You couldn't ask for better.

reviews.author: PatricIa Dail
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the work that was done on my 2000 olds.I have got to keep it going a few more years. Thank You guys

reviews.author: Daphne Kennedy
reviews.text: Fast service great prices, awesome customer service. I would go back in an instant without thinking twice about it.

reviews.author: Josh A
reviews.text: Polite, professional, and will not rip you off. They seem knowledgeable and will take the time to explain things without confusion.

reviews.author: kayla strayer
reviews.text: I’m glad I went here for a second opinion. Thank you for your honesty, integrity and friendly service.

reviews.author: Lisa Smith
reviews.text: Absolutely the best service!! They were the most honest mechanic shop I have ever taken a car to. They looked it over and quoted me a price for parts and labor. Then when they completed the work they called and said there wasn't as much needed as they thought and it came out to less than half what they quoted me. Y'all in my 58 years I have never had that happen. They could have charged me the initial price and I never would have known!! Honest mechanics do exist and they are at J & J Automotive.

reviews.author: Vincent Sullivan
reviews.text: Best garage in New Bern!! Prices are great and best service. Not sure why anyone would go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Double 7
reviews.text: I thought finally I found a place where I can trust people with my car, but unfortunately, I don’t recommend anybody doing business with him. My car was there for three weeks. They don’t take my service Amy or Megan keep lying to me every day. Excuse they schedule me an appointment. I’ll check what’s wrong with my car I have to get a tow again. That cost me $130 twice. They replace our car and they was like where is your car? I told him it’s at the shop at this place, they was like this is the best shop. Not sure why they don’t take your business. I was like this what I’ve had to. I need my vehicle and they catch me an appointment. They didn’t give me any answer so I have to get it to someone else where they appreciate my business and they got it look out that’s when I forget it and order the part and start on it not like them.
